name: PADS Gold
title: PADS Gold Premium Whole-Home Audio Package
description: Premium whole-home audio distribution package with doorbell integration, paging system, PM 4.1 matrix mixer, and PDM distribution module.
detailTitle: PADS Gold Premium Whole-Home Audio Distribution Package
detailDescription: The PADS Gold package is the premium upgrade from the PADS Silver, adding a doorbell input (PDB), paging system (PPT), PM 4.1 matrix mixer, PH distribution hub, and PDM distribution module. This full-featured system provides complete whole-home audio with paging, doorbell chimes through speakers, and advanced zone management.

specifications.value: In-wall amplifier with IR remote + paging

features: Doorbell input (PDB) for chimes through speakers
PPT paging system for whole-home intercom
PM 4.1 matrix mixer for multiple source selection
PH distribution hub for zone management
PDM distribution module for expanded capabilities
PARI in-wall amplifiers with IR remote in every zone
applications: Custom home theater and audio installations
